randomized_domain.draw: one random.Random(master_seed * 100 + k) per entry point (k = 1 case_split_loaded, 2 ignition_booking_s, 3 book_reserve_and_residual, 4 ground_supply, 6 evaluate): case_split_loaded: case 70 % log-uniform 1e-3..1e3 kg, 30 % uniform 0..20 rounded to 0..6 decimals, fractions uniform 0..1 (10 % exactly 0, 5 % up to 1e3), an invalid argument with probability 0.03; ignition_booking_s: attempts from E-X02 (probability 0.8 a valid int), dwell uniform 0..150 s (20 % exactly 120.0), evidence from E-X02; book_reserve_and_residual: 0..8 evaluations over a random line map (phase xe_mode / transition / start / reserve / residual, reserve_base True with probability 0.9), kg None / 0.0 / a mass, fractions 0.2 / 0.02 (80 %) or random 0..1; ground_supply: 0..5 calculated lines, the four procedure keys (90 %), values None / 0.0 / a mass, margin 0.2 (90 %); evaluate: R-X01 with A (60 %) every item value kept / None / a random positive number (probabilities 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.25), B (30 %) A plus each line's presence replaced with probability 0.1 by a zero or non-zero presence state, C (10 %) A plus one random line given CONDITIONAL_ON_C1_FLIGHT_SELECTION or ABSENT_UNDER_READING

checks.statement: LOADED split closes: |mission_usable_kg + reserve_kg + residual_kg - case_kg| <= 1e-12 x max(1, case_kg) on every returned X1 split (the residual is a sub-line inside the case, never added again)
reserve / residual booked once: every COMPUTED booking has loaded_kg == rk(usable + residual) with usable = base + reserve; floors equal totals
ground supply: supply_kg == rk(base x 1.2), margin_kg == rk(0.2 x base) with base the sum of the calculated and procedure lines
